title: Holomorphic functions on complete Hermitian manifolds with flat Chern connection, II
summary: In this paper, we prove several results concerning the function theory of complete Hermitian manifolds with vanishing Chern curvature, which we refer to as complete Chern-flat manifolds. First, we prove that any complete simply connected Chern-flat manifold is elliptic in the sense of Gromov. Moreover, it is biholomorphic to a complex Lie group if the torsion has polynomial growth. Next, we obtain sharp dimension estimates for holomorphic functions of polynomial growth on complete Chern-flat manifolds, with no growth assumption on the torsion.
